summary: Solutions‑oriented IT leader with nearly 28 years of experience managing large, 24x7 IT environments, designing data centers, deploying SaaS and hybrid cloud solutions, and leading cross‑functional teams across multiple regions.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology
responsibilities: Designed and deployed the company’s first data center for a new SaaS product.
Led the transition from software sales to SaaS subscription model, generating recurring revenue.
Implemented hybrid cloud environment and cyber‑security policies.
Built and managed teams for data center operations and technical support.
Oversaw network design, monitoring, and maintenance.
Managed budgets, project management, and RFP responses.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Managed a $120M IT budget for county‑wide human services programs.
Served as project manager for a $2.5M system rollout to ~2,000 users.
Led a bi‑county steering committee for RFP release and vendor selection.
Supervised network administrators and designed high‑level network architecture.
Ensured compliance with HITECH/HIPAA security protocols.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Managed national point‑of‑sale network across 100+ retail locations and 5 distribution centers.
Oversaw ERP, accounting, and HR systems at corporate and manufacturing sites.
Acted as liaison between vendors, operations staff, and CFO on major projects.
Implemented Cisco routers/firewalls, Windows Server, and desktop support.
